name: Hoyne Bancorp Inc. Common Stock
summary: Hoyne Bancorp, Inc. functions as the holding company for Hoyne Savings Bank, which delivers a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. Its deposit offerings encompass NOW accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, and certificates of deposit. Furthermore, the company extends various credit solutions, including financing for commercial real estate (such as construction projects), commercial and industrial enterprises, mortgages for residential properties with one to four units, home equity loans and lines of credit, and other forms of consumer lending. This institution was established in 1887 and maintains its headquarters in Chicago, Illinois.
